requirements.requirement: The system must include a relevance_score field in each clinical trial object returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must preserve the original response structure from evaluate_care_facade while adding the relevance_score field without removing existing fields.
The system must map the relevance_score from clinical_trials_service output directly to the facade response without transformation that alters its numeric value.
The system must ensure relevance_score is a normalized numeric value between 0 and 1 in the facade response.
The system must include relevance_score for all trials when clinical_trials_service provides the value (happy path full propagation).
The system must omit or set relevance_score to null when the upstream service does not provide a score (exception path: missing score).
The system must not fail the entire facade response if relevance_score is missing for one or more trials.
The system must maintain consistent field naming (relevance_score) across all clinical trial responses returned to the chat layer.
The system must ensure the relevance_score field is serializable in JSON without causing schema validation errors.
The system must include relevance_score in responses consumed by the chat layer such that downstream LLM prompts can access it.
The system must present relevance_score as a machine-readable numeric field rather than embedded text to support LLM reasoning.
The system must ensure relevance_score is consistently included in all trials within the same response to avoid LLM inconsistency during comparison.
The system must not round or truncate relevance_score in a way that materially reduces precision needed for LLM ranking decisions.
The system must ensure relevance_score is aligned with the schema defined in EVAL-CT-REL-001 (contract consistency).
The system must handle invalid relevance_score values from upstream (e.g., <0 or >1) by setting the field to null and not propagating invalid data (exception path: invalid score).
The system must allow the chat layer to sort or rank trials using relevance_score without additional transformation.
